options(width = 90)

```{r message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(readr)
Prac_DeptSatis <- read_csv("G:/Shared drives/Foundations of Statistics, Spring 2023 and beyond/Exams/Exam 2/Prac_DeptSatis.csv")
```

```{r}
by(Prac_DeptSatis$Satis, Prac_DeptSatis$Type, function(x) {
  c(n      = length(x),
    mean   = round(mean(x), 2),
    sd     = round(sd(x), 2),
    median = round(median(x), 2),
    min    = min(x),
    max    = max(x),
    se     = round(sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)), 2))
})
```

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(car)
leveneTest(y = Prac_DeptSatis$Satis,  
           group = Prac_DeptSatis$Type, 
           center = mean)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
t.test(Prac_DeptSatis$Satis ~ Prac_DeptSatis$Type,
       alternative = "two.sided",
       mu = 0,
       conf.level = 0.95,
       var.equal = FALSE)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
t.test(Prac_DeptSatis$Satis ~ Prac_DeptSatis$Type,
       alternative = "two.sided",
       mu = 0,
       conf.level = 0.95,
       var.equal = TRUE)
```
